conviction_note: Nothing found that the price does not already hold: the fare hikes that lift Q1 revenue are public and were inside the 2026-07-14 guide, the margin question (Q4 FY26 OP margin 13.7% against a 26.8% full-year guide) is computable by anyone from the 短信, and the crowded margin long is already in the baseline lean; the findings net to -0.05 and p_up sits at 50 on an 8% scale, so the scaled number is 0. A held forecast is the likely outcome and moves nothing on its own.
bar: Company FY27/5 guide (2026-07-14 決算短信): revenue 48,500m, OP 13,000m, 経常 13,100m, no H1 or quarterly guide (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260714592943.pdf). IFIS consensus (4 analysts): revenue 49,493m, OP 13,425m, 経常 13,510m (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=581A, data 2026-10-14). There is no quarterly consensus, so the Q1 bar is a pro-rata share of the guide: FY26 Q1 revenue 9,582m was 23.1% of the year, so about 11.2bn against the guide. print_vs_bar_pct is an inference on revenue, roughly 11.5bn against 11.2bn, and is capped small because the bar is not a sourced quarterly number.
positioning_check: JPX short register 2026-10-14: 0.0%, no disclosed position at or above 0.5%, unchanged (baseline). 信用倍率 44.41x (kabutan quote page, 2026-10-15 https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=581A), so leveraged retail is heavily crowded long. 貸借銘柄 since 2026-09-11, so margin shorting has been possible for only a month. The Yahoo board's last-week sentiment reads 92% buy, 0% sell (https://finance.yahoo.co.jp/quote/581A.T/forum, 2026-10-15). There is no option market and no skew. The baseline priced_lean is -1.22, of which margin_overhang is -0.82 and runup -0.39. The Nikkei was down 3.7% intraday on 10-15 (kabutan header), so the 追証 (margin call) risk is live.

findings.finding: Kanto taxi fare hikes reach a full quarter for the first time in Q1 (Jun-Aug 2026): Tokyo 23 wards, Musashino and Mitaka from 2026-04-20 (last revision there +14.24%; reported ~+10% this time), and Tama, Kanagawa, Saitama, Chiba and Gunma from 2026-03-16. Q4 FY26 already had ARPR at 189 yen (+22.7% YoY) on a part-quarter. The 1Q YoY revenue headline is therefore likely around +20-25% against a +17% FY guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: One print only: the FY26 results plus the first FY27 guide on 2026-07-14 15:30 moved +20.41% on 07-15 (Yahoo daily bars). That move was driven by the guide, not by quarterly revenue. There is no quarterly-surprise history.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The fare hikes were public months before the 2026-07-14 guide, and the guide was set with them known, so this lands inside guidance. What is not visible is the size: GO publishes no monthly figures, so the market has not seen how much of the hike reached ARPR in a full quarter. If it were fully priced, IFIS revenue would sit well above the guide; it sits only 2% above (49.5bn vs 48.5bn), even though Q4 FY26 annualised (45.4bn) already gets most of the way to the guide.
findings.independence: Second Kanto notice for the other prefectures: https://wwwtb.mlit.go.jp/kanto/content/000367434.pdf (2026-02-13). The Q4 ARPR and ride counts come from the company's own presentation, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260714593008.pdf, which is a different document.

findings.finding: The OP guide (13.0bn, 26.8% margin) needs the margin roughly doubled from Q4 FY26 (OP 1,550m on 11,351m revenue, 13.7%; adjusted EBITDA margin 16.5%), and the company itself said the Q4 cost increase was strategic, not seasonal, and that it will keep deploying cost flexibly. So Q1 OP progress could print below the ~22-25% share the market expects, even with revenue ahead.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior quarterly margin surprise exists for this name as a listed company. The only print, FY26 with the guide, rose +20.41%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. Every number here is in the public 短信 and presentation, and four analysts with 13.4bn OP consensus have done the same arithmetic. What is not public is the Q1 marketing spend. If the market feared a margin shortfall, consensus OP would sit below the guide rather than 3% above it, and the stock would not trade at 25x the company EPS.
findings.independence: kabutan's quarterly table gives the same Q3/Q4 OP from a separate source: https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=581A. It is the same underlying 短信, so this does not count as independent evidence.

findings.finding: Leveraged retail is crowded long into the print (信用倍率 44.41x, Yahoo board 92% buy / 0% sell over the last week), on a day the Nikkei fell 3.7% intraday. A crowded margin long is the one setup in which an in-line print still finds sellers (追証 and sell-the-news), and the 10-07 TOPIX inclusion was already read as 材料出尽くし.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 10-07 TOPIX-inclusion announcement the stock fell -1.61% and -0.82% over the next two sessions (kabutan 10-08 article; Yahoo bars). After the 09-15 Waymo partnership it reversed from +5.7% to -8.31% the next day. Good news has been sold twice since September.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the baseline's margin_overhang component (-0.82) already carries the margin ratio, and this finding agrees with it. The only addition is the board's one-sided sentiment together with a falling index on entry day, which raises the odds of forced selling on 10-16. Sized small for that reason.
findings.independence: kabutan 2026-10-08 on TOPIX inclusions being sold as 材料出尽くし: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=581A&b=n202610080308

outside_window.finding: TOPIX inclusion under the new rules (announced 2026-10-07) takes effect at the end-October periodic replacement. The passive buying lands on the effective date, after the 10-16 exit.
Waymo / Nihon Kotsu partnership targets about 100 driverless robotaxis in Tokyo during 2027. The commercial impact and the related autonomous-driving costs resolve years out.

baseline_tension: Roughly agrees with the baseline: lean -1.22 from the margin overhang, a +7.8% 20-day run-up but -7.8% over 5 days. The strongest positive the release could carry is a held FY guide on Q1 revenue +20-25% YoY with margins recovering toward guide pace, plus any Q1 KPI showing ARPR near 200 yen. I looked for returns and revisions and found none pending. The positives and negatives roughly cancel, and nothing found is unseen by the market.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a 進捗率 anyone can compute from the last 短信): the margin-pace finding went from -0.5 to -0.25, and p_up moved from 49 to 50.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): I wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension. I had already looked for returns and revisions. The positioning negative went from -0.5 to -0.3 because it mostly restates the baseline's own margin_overhang lean.
Left standing: the fare-hike positive (+0.5) and abs_move_pct 8.0.
